# User Searcher

> > User Searcher provides free OSINT tools for reverse username search, phone lookup, email discovery, and social media profile investigation across 2000+ platforms.

User Searcher is a comprehensive open-source intelligence (OSINT) platform offering specialized search tools for TikTok, Discord, phone numbers, and email addresses. The service emphasizes privacy compliance with GDPR standards while enabling identity verification and profile discovery across social media networks, dating sites, and communication platforms.

## Key Topics

- Username Search
- Reverse Phone Lookup
- Email Finder
- TikTok Profile Search
- Discord ID Lookup
- OSINT Tools
- Social Media Investigation
- Identity Verification
- Caller Identification
- Anonymous Browsing
- Profile Discovery
- GDPR Compliance
- Spam Detection
- Carrier Lookup

## Core Search Tools

- [User Searcher Homepage](https://www.user-searcher.com): Main platform for reverse username search across 2000+ social media and dating sites
- [OSINT Tools Hub](https://www.user-searcher.com/tools): Comprehensive collection of open-source intelligence tools for username, Discord, phone, email, and TikTok searches
- [About User Searcher](https://www.user-searcher.com/about-us): Platform overview and capabilities for username search across social media and dating platforms

## Phone & Email Intelligence

- [Phone Searcher - Reverse Phone Lookup](https://www.user-searcher.com/phone-searcher): Free reverse phone lookup tool for caller ID and carrier identification across Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile networks
- [Mail Searcher - Email Finder](https://www.user-searcher.com/mail-searcher): Email address discovery tool scanning 100+ providers with GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance

## Social Media Search Tools

- [TikTok Username Search](https://www.user-searcher.com/tiktok-searcher): TikTok username lookup revealing followers, hearts, videos, and complete profile information
- [TikTok Viewer - Anonymous Browsing](https://www.user-searcher.com/tiktok-viewer): Watch TikTok profiles and videos anonymously without requiring an account
- [Discord ID Lookup](https://www.user-searcher.com/discord-searcher): Discord user search showing profiles, badges, banners, and Nitro subscription status
